semantics.proceduralWallMidline: identically the road centreline — the offset is symmetric in side and nothing downstream moves it laterally
semantics.factualWallMidline: midpoint of the two opposing factual first-hit walls; NOT a road centreline
semantics.dSign: positive outward, away from the carriageway
